frame: BagRoot: origin = calibrated bag centre on the sticker (top) plane. +X = right as seen by the user, +Z = horizontal direction from the bag towards the user (camera forward projected, recomputed when the mode guide appears), +Y = up. Units: metres.

layerHeightsAboveTable.note: Every flat card needs its own height, otherwise overlapping cards z-fight (seen in the renders). Also register them in a VisionOSSortingGroup in this order.

worldColours.note: All guide textures are white and tinted with these colours (URP Unlit transparent, _BaseColor).

modeButtons.input: direct touch (fingertip enters collider) or gaze + pinch via MoodiumSpatialInteractionController; add VisionOSHoverEffect
modeButtons.recommendedBadge: small accent dot (rhythm_combo_bead_full, 0.012 m) at the button's far-right edge when the mood check recommends that mode

modeToast.note: In breath mode the toast is skipped once the word row is in use.

ring.phase: 0 right after a squeeze point, 1 at the next one
ring.fallback: rhythm_ring_circle on a quad, scaled (line gets thicker as it grows)

sparkles.path: spawn on the bag outline + 0.014, travel outwards 0.09-0.15 m along the table (ease-out), arc up at most 0.03 m; never over the bag footprint

arc.side: far side of the bag (away from the user)

hintFirstTime.show: first 3 squeeze points after entering the mode

breath.outline: every breath element hugs the bag footprint: superellipse, exponent 3.4, half size (width/2, length/2); 'offset' = distance outwards from it

tide.mesh: RoundedRectBandMesh with breath_tide_band (v = 1 outer edge carries a bright crest)

trace.track: RoundedRectBandMesh, rhythm_ring_band, offset 0.018, bandWidth 0.004, tint soft, alpha 0.15, always on
trace.line: RoundedRectBandMesh, rhythm_ring_band, innerOffset 0.017, bandWidth 0.006, tint accent, fill = progress
trace.heads: two breath_trace_head sprites (0.016 m, flat on the table) at both ends of the line; they start together at the middle of the near side and meet behind the bag
trace.onFull: line flashes white 0.15 s + 12 motes burst outwards from the meeting point

ripples.when: exhale only; one ripple at release, then every 1.2 s while exhaling (max 3)

inhale.texture: breath_mote (+ a 0.012 m breath_mote glow flat on the table)
inhale.path: ease towards the tide crest along the table, alpha sin(pi * t)

exhale.path: outwards along the table 0.11-0.18 m, rising at most 0.04 m, slight sway, alpha 1 -> 0

motes.rule: particles never enter the volume above the bag footprint

hints.longer: guide_hint_longer - once, after 3 holds shorter than 1.2 s

bagSquash.note: visual only; the physical bag is what the user really squeezes

rule: The space above the bag belongs to the bag. Every guide element lies on the table around the bag (or is printed on the table in front of it). Nothing floats above the bag footprint: no text, no orb, no particles.

tableTextSlot.what: Text printed on the table between the bag and the mode buttons. Never above the bag.
tableTextSlot.anchor: x = 0, y = tableY, z = length/2 + d (d = distance beyond the near bag edge, to the centre of the card)
tableTextSlot.tilt: 30 deg: the card's far edge is lifted so it reads at a seated viewing angle; pivot on the near edge; fixed, does not billboard
